# Pull Request Evidence

## Problem

Describe the observed failure, supported use case, or maintenance risk.

## Conformance Impact

Identify the affected level, routes, language slices, and contract surfaces.

## Evidence

- Cases or fixtures added or changed:
- Commands and results:
- Context-budget change:
- External or dynamic surfaces not verified:

## Safety Checklist

- [ ] Behavior and protected contracts remain unchanged unless migration is explicitly in scope.
- [ ] The change adds no spelling-only forbidden-word rule.
- [ ] Generated datasets are current.
- [ ] Offline checks pass.
- [ ] User-visible or normative changes appear in the changelog.
